name: betterzcode
description: Your agent cannot call a task done without proving it, and cannot cite a source it never opened. Separate agents check the plan, write the code, review it and verify it by execution; hooks block any success verdict no executed test supports, any report citing a page that was never fetched, and in security runs a finding enters the report only once independently reproduced — the hooks block a FINDINGS: VERIFIED signature when no verification command ran, and a red-team impact mode whose attack commands a PreToolUse gate physically blocks until a test/dev scope is authorized. An agent that writes is never an agent that judges.
